ui_beam.png:
A long horizontal carved wooden beam, like the top rail of an old signboard, with a simple repeating chiselled groove along its middle and a small rounded boss at each end. Warm mid-brown timber with darker grain lines and lighter worn highlights along the top edge.

It is a user-interface ornament for a cute cartoon game set in a cat ninja tower, so it must match that world:
hand-carved wood and washi paper, warm and slightly worn, never sleek or modern.
The wood grain and every carved detail must run HORIZONTALLY along its length, because the game stretches this image sideways to fit different widths - anything vertical would smear.
Draw ONLY the object itself, centred, filling the frame edge to edge along its long axis with a small margin.
Everything must be SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO symbols, NO watermark - the game writes its own text on top,
so the middle must be left completely plain and empty.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Bold enough to still read when shrunk: no hairline detail.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green in the object.
Output 1536x256 PNG. Save the image as ui_beam.png in the current directory and report the path.
